scope: Independent source/byte/AST review only; no tests, adb, device, network, worktree or git operation

findings.subject: Exception and acceptance boundary
findings.finding: Collection occurs only if CONSOLE.start did not produce console_launch; the original exception object is re-raised. Collector errors attach INCOMPLETE metadata. No path changes launch status to PASS.

findings.subject: Read-only identity boundary
findings.finding: The remote UUID path and emulator serial are strictly validated; exactly five file reads and one bounded state read use the same session. Symlinks/nonregular remote paths are rejected; no root, launch, logcat-clear, kill or restart command is introduced on the device.

findings.subject: Raw stream and bounded collection
findings.finding: stdout/stderr are kept as original binary prefixes with separate hashes and actual returncodes. Per-command 2 s / 64 KiB and aggregate 8 s / 256 KiB are explicit; timeout, cap, spawn, storage and incomplete EOF are recorded, never accepted as complete launch evidence.

findings.subject: Original acceptance gates
findings.finding: All 27 other existing definitions are AST-identical, including launch scripts, actual UID/process/cgroup/survival checks, marker/prefix/ANR rules. The successful launch/root path is unchanged.

findings.subject: Reported test evidence
findings.finding: Author logs bind nine focused green methods and original missing-diagnostic errors to frozen source; reviewed without rerunning. The three actual Exit1 console transcripts remain failures.

limits: Actual inner device program Exit1 is still undiagnosed until a later real run yields readable launch/session originals
Permission/missing-file/nonzero/limited reads remain diagnostic failures or incomplete evidence
Local evidence serialization follows the separately bounded external-command collection period
No emulator launch, logger continuity or Android acceptance is granted
